about_the_game:
Everyday Life Fragments tells the story of Artyom — a father watching his daughter slowly die while the system fails them at every turn. When endless waiting lists and denied insurance claims leave him with nothing, he breaks. Artyom starts hunting for what she needs himself — staging accidents, making people disappear.
With every kill, he sinks deeper into his own mind, where reality begins to tear apart at the seams.

This isn’t a typical horror game. Yes, there are monsters — but they all live inside Artyom’s head.

The real horror is watching a good man turn into something unrecognizable, one choice at a time.

What You’ll Do

  • Make murders look like accidents or suicides

  • Sneak into forbidden places and avoid being caught

  • Endure twisted nightmare sequences that worsen after each kill

  • Piece together the truth through scattered notes, photos, and Artyom’s broken memories

  • Make choices that push Artyom toward either redemption or damnation

  • Discover that the truth behind everything is far worse than you ever imagined
